goal: Prevent local attackers on another user account from hijacking the node over IPv6
Stop bitcoind from writing an RPC cookie if the default IPv4 loopback port is occupied
Require IPv4 loopback binding to succeed by default and fail closed when explicit -rpcbind targets fail
agreement: Strong support for plugging a real local credential leak (janb84, winterrdog)
Unaddressed objection: deduplication ignores IPv6 scope IDs, dropping interface binds (l0rinc)
Open suggestions on test structure and adding -rpcallowip to the startup failure hint (l0rinc)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it fixes a local security vulnerability that leaks plaintext RPC auth cookies to foreign processes
Prevents an untrusted local user from using stolen credentials to commandeer the node over IPv6
